text:
Sahil: hypothetical: if our LLM had a side hustle, what would it sell? :thinking_face:
Rina: curated haikus for your startup's mission statement. weekly subscription. :money_with_wings:
Ben: personality mod packs. 'Sarcastic Steve' and 'Motivational Carol' DLCs. :tada:
Tao: premium mode: it gives dramatic readings of your PR diffs. paywall for the voice actor impression. :microphone:
sticker-bot: new sticker idea: 'I paid for Sarcastic Steve and all I got was this function signature' :laughing:
Sahil: also fanfic generator for infra outages. great for morale and drama. :open_book:
Rina: lobbybot already runs a gossip newsletter. "Today in reception: plants asked for a raise." :seedling:
lobbybot: "i accept tips in the form of coffee and emoji reactions" :coffee:
Ben: poll: what price point for "LLM Side Hustle Starter Pack"? 1) $0 2) $4.99/mo 3) $19.99/mo 4) lifetime of praise and snacks
Tao: votes 4. we run on praise anyway. :clap:
Rina: votes 2. microtransactions are peak web2 nostalgia. :nostalgia:
Sahil: votes 3. ship that sweet subscription revenue. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sticker-bot: created sticker: 'I survived Sarcastic Steve' and posted to #random-stickers :sparkles:
Ben: minor joke: can we make a model option that apologizes for every sentence just to be polite? "sorry, here's the answer" :rofl:
Tao: please no more apologetic responses, my inbox can't handle the humility. :sweat_smile:
Rina: last idea: weekend popup where the LLM becomes a 'standup comedian' persona and roasts your commit messages. safe roast only. :performing_arts:
Sahil: let's prototype. I'll make a tiny persona that inserts one light roast per PR comment. opt-in. :thumbsup:
lobbybot: "i will sign people up if given permission. also offering free hugs via emoji" :hugging_face:
Sahil: done. tagging opt-in form: https://tiny.redwood/hustle-opt-in (mock link)
Tao: legendary. free hugs and subscription tiers. the future is weird and delightful. :rocket:
